about.title: The Fasske family, and the crew that drives Big Blue.
text: We are the Fasske family. Josh owns the company and has been in the plumbing trade since 2007. Brittani runs the office and answers the calls, and the two of them have three kids, Graham, Ellisyn and Greyson. Family is our core value.

We understand how frustrating and shocking it can be to allow a company to begin a job in your home, expecting an originally agreed upon price, and once the job is complete the tech informs you that the bill has doubled or tripled without warning. We strongly believe in the importance of giving our customers all of the information available and presenting them with options for their particular needs.

Our team is proud to offer the best plumbing services in League City and the surrounding areas. We strive for complete customer satisfaction and to hit a home run every time, and we promise to treat your family and home like it's our own.
about.imageAlt: Two Grand Slam Plumbing technicians standing in front of the company van

faqs.a: Free estimates are available. For a quote of services, schedule an appointment and we will come and look at the job.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Call 832-864-3334 or book online. If you book online, give us your best three days and times and we will contact you by phone or email as quickly as possible to confirm. There is an emergency option if the request cannot wait.

faqs.q: Will the price change once the work has started?
faqs.a: No. We present you with the options and the price for your particular needs before the job begins, which is the whole point of honest upfront pricing.
Yes. Joshua Fasske is a Responsible Master Plumber, RMP #42025, licensed by the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners.

faqs.q: Do you do small jobs as well as big ones?
faqs.a: Yes. Repairs and installs, we do it all, large or small.

faqs.q: Does a tankless water heater need servicing?
faqs.a: Yes. The manufacturer requires annual maintenance to keep the warranty current, so plan on a visit once a year with a tankless unit.

faqs.q: Can you come out after hours?
faqs.a: We answer the phone on Saturdays and in the evening, and we come out after hours for a leak that will not keep. Select the emergency option when you book so the request is flagged.

reviews.author: Dennis Stockman, League City
reviews.text: I called in the morning, Josh and Justin were here shortly after noon the same day. Josh told me what I needed and quoted me a price. They removed the old hot water heater and related parts, installed the new unit and other need items. They cleaned up the work site and were gone by 3 PM.

reviews.author: Christy Luetzow
reviews.text: Grand Slam Plumbing is amazing and the service is outstanding! They are fast, reliable, friendly and honest! The owner Josh takes pride in his work and he is extremely knowledgeable, helpful and trustworthy! He goes the extra mile to spend time explaining everything in detail!

reviews.author: Melissa Cooper, Houston
reviews.text: Josh and his team traveled a little farther than they normally would to take care of some issues at our house in Houston. They replaced an old toilet, and all that that entails, as well as troubleshot a pressure issue. He communicated along the way and got the job done in a timely manner. He's our go-to plumbing service.
